articles.summary: 美国前总统特朗普近期暗示在对伊战争中可以「牺牲」圣地亚哥和洛杉矶等城市，此番言论遭到民主党与共和党政客的一致抨击与强烈不满。

articles.title: What’s behind Israel’s growing shift to the right?
articles.excerpt: Three years after the October 7 attacks, the politics of Israeli society has shifted further right.
articles.summary: 在10月7日袭击事件发生三年后，以色列社会政治氛围显著右倾。分析指出，这一趋势反映了该国政界及民众在安全与地缘政治立场上的深刻调整。

articles.title: Yemeni forces launch offensive to retake Houthi-held al-Waziiya in Taiz
articles.excerpt: The mountainous district is key to control of Mocha, the Red Sea port the Houthis seized last month.
articles.summary: 也门政府军发起军事攻势，试图夺回塔伊兹省被胡塞武装控制的阿尔瓦齐亚区（al-Waziiya）。该地区战略地位重要，是控制红海港口摩卡的关键枢纽。

articles.title: Sudan’s al-Burhan rejects talks, vows to retake all territory from RSF
articles.excerpt: At least 10 civilians were killed in West Kordofan and 5,500 displaced in Blue Nile as clashes widened on Tuesday.
articles.summary: 苏丹武装部队总司令布尔汉拒绝与快速支援部队（RSF）谈判，誓言夺回所有领土。近期冲突加剧，西科尔多凡州至少10名平民遇害，青尼罗河州约5500人流离失所。

articles.title: South Sudan’s aid crisis deepens as food stocks run low

articles.summary: 受资金削减及苏丹难民持续涌入影响，南苏丹面临严重的粮食危机。若无法获得援助，预计到10月底将有超过100万人失去维持生命的食物救济。

articles.title: French mayor tear-gassed after shielding protesters from police

articles.title: Electric car bursts into flames at charging station in Turkiye
articles.excerpt: Turkiye’s first domestically produced electric SUV, the Togg T10X burst into flames at a charging station.
articles.summary: 土耳其本土生产的首款电动SUV车型Togg T10X，近期在充电站发生起火事故，现场火光冲天。目前相关方面尚未公布具体事故原因。

articles.title: ‘We are desperate’: Venezuela’s power cuts fuel growing public anger

articles.summary: 委内瑞拉频繁发生大规模停电，导致公众愤怒情绪不断升级，并引发针对代理总统德尔西·罗德里格斯政府的抗议活动，民众称生活陷入绝望。

articles.title: Christa Pike lawyers say she is speaking one week after failed execution
